name: Beauty Salon Marketing System
short: Editable salon campaigns, promotions and content planning templates in one practical system.
audience: Salon owners, nail artists, lash technicians and independent beauty professionals
includes: Salon brand and customer profile worksheet
90 editable caption starters with review checklist
outcomes: Plan campaigns without starting from scratch
Save time on everyday marketing tasks
sample: Draft a friendly, accurate Instagram promotion for a salon's new treatment. Confirm the actual price, availability and terms before publishing.

name: Cleaning Business Operations Kit
short: Make customer enquiries, quoting and follow-ups more consistent with ready-to-use operations templates.
audience: Domestic cleaners, commercial cleaning teams and independent service providers
includes: Review request and repeat booking workflows
sample: Write a clear, friendly reply to a homeowner asking for a regular cleaning quote. Ask for the property size, frequency, location and special requirements before giving a price.

name: Fitness Client & Content Planner
short: Show up online with confidence—even when your calendar is full.
audience: Personal trainers, fitness coaches and independent instructors
outcomes: Create content with a repeatable process
sample: Create a week of beginner-friendly social posts for a personal trainer. Keep advice general, avoid medical claims, and finish each post with a helpful question for readers.

name: Small Business Workflow Library
short: Reusable checklists, business planning templates and structured operating workflows.
audience: Founders, freelancers and small business owners exploring AI
sample: Outline the steps in a repeatable customer enquiry-to-booking workflow for a small service business, with clear owner responsibilities.

name: 30-Day Social Content Planning System
short: One clear month of content planning, without the overwhelm.
audience: Solo entrepreneurs and small teams who want a practical posting routine
outcomes: Plan a month of content in one place
sample: Give me 12 helpful Instagram post ideas for a [type of business] serving [audience]. Group them into education, behind-the-scenes, trust-building and offers.

name: Business Operations & Growth Bundle
short: A coordinated toolkit for planning, creating and communicating with clarity.
audience: Business owners ready for a more joined-up approach to content and operations
includes: Service workflow and client communication collection
outcomes: Make planning and publishing more repeatable
sample: Help me plan a realistic four-week marketing sprint for my [business]. Suggest one main goal, three measurable priorities and a simple weekly checklist.
